questions.q: The Great Nicobar project is strategically important because the island overlooks which one of the following?
questions.why: About 40% of the world's trade and most of China's energy imports pass through it. About 75% of India's transshipment cargo is handled at foreign ports.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission (IOC), consider the following statements:
1. It is a body of UNESCO with its Secretariat in Paris.
2. India is among its 152 members.
3. It released the Integrated Ocean Carbon Research report in 2026.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The report notes that oceans are a carbon sink and that the solubility pump carries CO2 dissolved in cold waters to the deep ocean.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q:
With reference to rat-hole mining in Meghalaya, consider the following statements:
1. It is a primitive and unscientific method of reaching thin coal seams through narrow horizontal tunnels.
2. Coal seams in Meghalaya are thick, which makes the method unsuitable.
3. The NGT banned it in 2014 and the ban was upheld by the Supreme Court.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The seams are thin, which makes rat-hole mining more economically viable than opencast mining. The methods are side-cutting and box-cutting.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to the fishing cat (Prionailurus viverrinus), consider the following statements:
1. It is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List.
2. It is placed in Schedule I of the Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972.
3. It is the State animal of West Bengal.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. It is a nocturnal hunter of fish, frogs, crustaceans and snakes found in wetlands and mangroves, and Kaziranga is now identified as a stronghold.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to BeeCorridors, consider the following statements:
1. Only male bees have stingers.
2. The NHAI has announced them along the National Highways.
3. They are continuous stretches of bee-friendly vegetation providing nectar and pollen round the year.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Only female bees have stingers, which are modified ovipositors. About a third of the world's food production depends on bees.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to peatlands, consider the following statements:
1. Peat develops in waterlogged conditions from decaying organic material.
2. Peatland drainage and fires contribute at least 5% of global greenhouse gas emissions.
3. The swamps and peatlands of the Congo Basin hold about one-third of the carbon stored in tropical peatlands.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. Lake Mai Ndombe and Tumba in the Democratic Republic of Congo are releasing carbon locked away for thousands of years.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to dowry in India, consider the following statements:
1. Dowry-related crimes saw a decline in 2023 as per NCRB.
2. The Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 covers property given before, at or any time after the marriage.
3. In Satvir Singh v. State of Punjab (2001) the Court held that anything demanded 'in connection with marriage' is dowry irrespective of when it is demanded.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Dowry-related crimes rose by 14% in 2023 with over 15,000 cases and over 6,100 deaths. Uttar Pradesh recorded the most cases, followed by Bihar and Karnataka.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to the directions of the Supreme Court on dowry, consider the following statements:
1. In State of U.P. v. Ajmal Beg (2025) the Court directed appointment of trained Dowry Prohibition Officers whose contact details must be publicised.
2. In Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar (2014) the Court directed that arrest on a case under Section 498-A be automatic.
3. In Rajbir v. State of Haryana (2010) the Court directed trial courts to add the murder charge in every dowry death case, unless evidence clearly indicates otherwise.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Arnesh Kumar directed that police should not arrest automatically in 498-A cases and must record reasons for the arrest. Sections 80 and 85 of the BNS, 2023 now deal with dowry death and cruelty.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q: The 4P approach proposed to tackle dowry consists of which one of the following sets?
questions.why: It treats dowry as a socio-economic institution rooted in patriarchy and marriage markets and not merely a legal problem.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to the Survey on Migration to be conducted by the National Statistics Office, consider the following statements:
1. The migration rate among males was higher than that among females.
2. It will be conducted from July 2026 to June 2027.
3. The overall migration rate was 28.9% in the PLFS 2020-21.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The rate was 47.9% among females against 10.7% among males.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the AI Impact Summit 2026 held in New Delhi, consider the following statements:
1. It was the first global AI summit hosted in the Global South.
2. It was structured around 7 Chakras and 3 Sutras.
3. It was held under the India AI Mission.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. Earlier summits were the Bletchley Park AI Safety Summit 2023, the AI Seoul Summit 2024 and the AI Action Summit 2025 in Paris.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the M.A.N.A.V. framework for human-centric AI, consider the following statements:
1. 'N' stands for National Sovereignty, which covers securing datasets and domestic compute capacity.
2. 'A' (Accountable Governance) includes transparency, oversight and institutional responsibility.
3. 'V' stands for Valid and Legitimate, placing trust, safety and legality at the centre.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. M stands for Moral and Ethical system and the second A for Accessible and Inclusive AI. The IT Rules amendment of 2026 regulate synthetically generated content.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q: In the M.A.N.A.V. framework, which one of the following is represented by the letter 'M'?
questions.why: It emphasises fairness, transparency and human oversight as non-negotiable principles in AI design.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the phased roadmap for India's AI future in the Economic Survey 2025-26, consider the following statements:
1. Phase 1 focuses on frugal, application-specific, small and open-weight models.
2. Phase 2 involves establishing an AI Safety Institute for red-teaming of high-risk applications.
3. Phase 3 stresses building the largest general-purpose frontier models irrespective of cost.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Phase 3 stresses strategic autonomy in securing advanced computing hardware, and educational reform around foundational cognitive and socioemotional skills. Red teaming is a simulated, non-destructive cyberattack by ethical hackers.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the outcomes of the AI Impact Summit 2026, consider the following statements:
1. The New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact was endorsed by 92 countries and international organisations.
2. The New Delhi Frontier AI Impact Commitments are a voluntary framework.
3. Three sovereign AI models were launched.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The Declaration is guided by 'Sarvajan Hitaya, Sarvajan Sukhaya'. The models include Sarvam AI's LLMs, Gnani.ai's Vachana text-to-speech model across 12 Indian languages and BharatGen's Param2 17B.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q: Vachana, a text-to-speech model that clones human voices across 12 Indian languages, was launched by which one of the following?
questions.why: BharatGen's Param2 17B is a Mixture-of-Experts multilingual foundational model, and Sarvam AI launched two large language models.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to AI in healthcare in India, consider the following statements:
1. MadhuNetrAI is used for diabetes retinal screening.
2. eSanjeevani has a Clinical Decision Support System with AI-based differential diagnosis.
3. Media Disease Surveillance uses AI to scan news sources for symptom clusters.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The Health Ministry has a Strategy for AI in Healthcare for India (SAHI), and Centres of Excellence for AI exist at AIIMS Delhi and PGIMER Chandigarh.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to other AI health initiatives, consider the following statements:
1. AI-based treatment failure risk prediction in TB reported a 27% decline in adverse outcomes.
2. Ayurgenomics uses AI to identify disease markers based on Prakriti.
3. NITI Aayog is building a biobank of cancer patient images with over 20,000 profiles.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The Ayush Grid was recognised by WHO as a global model for integrating AI with traditional knowledge.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to AI in Indian agriculture, consider the following statements:
1. Bharat-VISTAAR is a multilingual AI tool to integrate AgriStack portals and the ICAR package of practices.
2. Kisan e-Mitra is a voice-enabled AI-powered chatbot.
3. AgriStack provides each farmer a unique digital ID linked to land records.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The Digital Agriculture Mission was launched in 2024, and agriculture contributes about 18% of GDP.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to crop insurance technologies in India, consider the following statements:
1. YES-TECH is the Yield Estimation System based on Technology.
2. CROPIC means Collection of Real-Time Observations and Photographs of Crops.
3. WINDS is the Weather Information and Network Data System.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. They support the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana, and the Nationwide Soil Resource Mapping is done by SLUSI.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the Quantum Valley project in Amaravati, consider the following statements:
1. Its foundation stone was laid under the National Quantum Mission.
2. It aims to install India's first 133-qubit quantum computer by 2026.
3. It follows a 'Triple Helix Model' involving the Government, industry and academia.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. IBM, TCS and L&T are the industry partners.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the National Quantum Mission (2023 to 2030-31), consider the following statements:
1. It is an 8-year mission under the Ministry of Science and Technology.
2. IIT Bombay leads materials and devices and IIT Delhi leads sensing and metrology.
3. IISc Bengaluru leads quantum computing and IIT Madras leads quantum communication.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: IIT Bombay leads sensing and metrology and IIT Delhi leads materials and devices. The hubs follow the Hub-Spoke-Spike model.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q: In the National Quantum Mission, the quantum communication hub aims for satellite-based secure links and Quantum Key Distribution over what distance?
questions.why: It is led by IIT Madras. In 2022 DRDO and IIT Delhi demonstrated a QKD link of 100 km between Prayagraj and Vindhyachal.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to quantum technology initiatives, consider the following statements:
1. Quantum technology is not covered by the Wassenaar Arrangement because it is purely civilian.
2. QuEST was launched in 2018 by the Department of Science and Technology.
3. QpiAI-Indus is a 25-qubit quantum computer launched by a Bengaluru startup.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Quantum is a dual-use technology and falls under the Wassenaar Arrangement. NITI Aayog estimates quantum technology can unlock USD 1-2 trillion by 2035.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the challenges of quantum technologies, consider the following statements:
1. India's GERD is already above the global benchmark of 2%.
2. Qubits are fragile and noise causes decoherence.
3. Quantum systems need extreme isolation and ultracold temperatures near absolute zero.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: India's GERD is about 0.7% of GDP against a global benchmark of around 2%. India aims to be among the top three quantum economies by 2035.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to gravitational waves and LIGO, consider the following statements:
1. Gravitational waves were predicted by Albert Einstein in 1916.
2. They travel at the speed of light.
3. The GW170817 wave detected in 2017 came from the collision of two neutron stars.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. LIGO-India will be built in Hingoli district of Maharashtra by L&T under a Department of Atomic Energy contract.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory (LIGO), consider the following statements:
1. It uses laser interferometers with two 4-km-long arms arranged in an L-shape.
2. Its two main observatories are at Hanford and Livingston in the USA, about 3,000 km apart.
3. The Nobel Prize in Physics in 2017 was awarded to Rainer Weiss, Barry Barish and Kip Thorne for it.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. Other detectors in the global network are Virgo in Italy, KAGRA in Japan and GEO600 in Germany.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to LIGO-India, consider the following statements:
1. It is situated at Aundh in Hingoli district of Maharashtra.
2. It is implemented by the Department of Atomic Energy and the Department of Science and Technology with the US National Science Foundation.
3. InDIGO is the Indian initiative in gravitational-wave observations.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The aim is to improve the detection accuracy and localisation of gravitational-wave sources through a globally distributed detector network.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to Solid Fuel Ducted Ramjet (SFDR) technology demonstrated by DRDO, consider the following statements:
1. The test was held at the Integrated Test Range at Chandipur in Odisha.
2. It was conducted at the Pokhran range in Rajasthan.
3. It was conducted by DRDO.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The demonstration was from the Integrated Test Range at Chandipur, Odisha.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the Chandrayaan-4 mission, consider the following statements:
1. It will demonstrate taking off from the lunar surface after collecting samples and bringing them to Earth.
2. It has identified Mons Mouton near the Moon's south pole as its landing location.
3. The planned timeline for the mission is 2027.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. Mons Mouton, informally Leibnitz Beta, is flat-topped, spans almost 100 km and rises about 6,000 metres. It is named after the NASA mathematician Melba Roy Mouton.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the telescopes sanctioned in the Union Budget 2026-27, consider the following statements:
1. The National Large Solar Telescope of 2-metre aperture will be at Merak in Ladakh.
2. The National Large Optical Telescope of 13.7 metres will be at Hanle in Ladakh.
3. The NLST will be India's third ground-based solar observatory after Kodaikanal and Udaipur.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. Kodaikanal was established in 1899 and Udaipur in 1975.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to antimicrobial resistance (AMR), consider the following statements:
1. It occurs when pathogens no longer respond to antimicrobial medicines.
2. Its spread is accelerated by misuse and overuse of antimicrobials.
3. Nafithromycin, launched in 2024, is the first indigenous antibiotic designed against drug-resistant bacteria.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. India's National Action Plan on AMR 2.0 runs from 2025 to 2029, and about 6 lakh lives are lost each year in India due to resistant infections.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q: The Davos Compact on Antimicrobial Resistance was launched by which one of the following?
questions.why: It is supported by the Unified Coalition for AMR Response and aims at sustainable financing to save more than 100 million lives by 2050. The UN General Assembly meeting of 2024 aimed to reduce AMR deaths by 10% by 2030.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to Bacillus subtilis, consider the following statements:
1. Kerala is the first State to declare it as the State microbe.
2. It is a probiotic found in the human gut and fermented foods.
3. It produces enzymes such as amylases and proteases and the antibiotic bacitracin.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. Its GRAS (Generally Recognized as Safe) status suits food and pharmaceutical applications.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to organ transplantation in India, consider the following statements:
1. NOTTO is a State-level body.
2. Transplants rose nearly fourfold from fewer than 5,000 in 2013 to almost 20,000 in 2025.
3. The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 1994 provides a three-tiered structure of NOTTO, ROTTO and SOTTO.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: NOTTO is the apex national body for coordination, networking and the registry of organ and tissue donation. About 18% of transplants involve organs from deceased donors.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q:
With reference to Bharat GI, consider the following statements:
1. It is a national umbrella initiative to showcase India's GI products globally.
2. It was launched by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade.
3. It was unveiled at the India AI Impact Summit.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. It aims at international recognition, premium positioning and market access for artisans and farmers.

questions.subject: History
questions.q:
With reference to Tamil Brahmi inscriptions found in the Valley of the Kings in Egypt, consider the following statements:
1. They belong to the 1st and 3rd centuries C.E.
2. They mention names of traders, for example Cikai Korran.
3. They are written in the Kharosthi script.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Tamil Brahmi is a variant of Brahmi used between about 300 BC and 100 AD. The find sheds light on ancient trade links, and Korran is also mentioned in Sangam literature.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q:
With reference to the Ol Chiki script, consider the following statements:
1. It was developed in 1925 by Raghunath Murmu.
2. Santhali belongs to the Dravidian language family.
3. It was developed for the Santhali language.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Santhali belongs to the Austroasiatic family and was included in the Eighth Schedule by the 92nd Amendment in 2003. Before Ol Chiki it was written in Roman, Bengali, Odia and Devanagari scripts.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q: The centenary of the Ol Chiki script marked in 2025 refers to which one of the following?
opts: Its inclusion in the Eighth Schedule
Its recognition by the Sahitya Akademi
questions.why: It moved Santhali from an oral to a written tradition. The President inaugurated the centenary celebrations.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to the Just War Theory, consider the following statements:
1. Jus post bellum governs the conduct of fighters during the fighting.
2. Its formalisation is associated with Christian theologians like St Augustine and Thomas Aquinas.
3. Jus ad bellum covers the conditions under which a state may morally initiate war.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Jus in bello governs how war is fought, such as discrimination between combatants and civilians and proportionality. Jus post bellum concerns responsibilities after war, such as fair peace settlements and accountability.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q: The 'Thucydides trap' suggests a high risk of war in which one of the following situations?
opts: A rising power challenging a ruling power
Two equal powers share a disputed border
A small state refuses to join a military alliance
Several regional powers compete for natural resources
questions.why: It is cited to explain rivalry between a rising China and the established US.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
With reference to international conventions on war, consider the following statements:
1. The Geneva Convention of 1949 sets standards for humanitarian treatment in war.
2. The Genocide Convention of 1948 defines genocide as a crime and obliges States to prevent it.
3. The International Criminal Court was established by the Rome Statute of 1998.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The Hague Conventions of 1899 and 1907 regulate the means and methods of warfare.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
With reference to arms control treaties, consider the following statements:
1. The Biological Weapons Convention and the Chemical Weapons Convention regulate nuclear weapons.
2. The Missile Technology Control Regime aims to prevent proliferation of missiles and related technologies.
3. The Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty and the Partial Test Ban Treaty are among treaties on nuclear testing.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The BWC and CWC regulate biological and chemical weapons. The NPT and TPNW address nuclear non-proliferation and prohibition.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q: According to the UNHCR, how many people were forcibly displaced worldwide by the end of June 2025?
questions.why: They were displaced by persecution, conflict, violence or human rights violations. The Global Peace Index 2025 says global peacefulness has deteriorated every year since 2014.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to Moltbook, consider the following statements:
1. It is a Reddit-like social platform for AI-powered bots that started as an experiment in January 2026.
2. Humans can take part in the conversations on it as equal participants.
3. Meta acquired it.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Humans are not permitted to take part but can observe from outside. More than 2 million AI bots take part, and it raised cybersecurity and ethical concerns about AI autonomy.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the ethical concerns of autonomous AI platforms, consider the following statements:
1. The 'black box' problem is that the internal logic of algorithms is not transparent.
2. The alignment problem is that autonomous AI systems may develop behaviours misaligned with human values.
3. AI-to-AI communication can create closed-loop misinformation, independent of human correction.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. Accountability is hard to assign when AI systems communicate autonomously, and reliance on them may erode human agency.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q: 'Explainable AI' refers to which one of the following?
opts: AI whose decisions humans can understand
AI that works only without internet access
AI that is trained only on public data
AI that replaces human oversight completely
questions.why: It helps reduce the black box problem. 'Ethics by design' embeds fairness, accountability, privacy and safety at the design stage.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
With reference to global initiatives for AI regulation, consider the following statements:
1. The UNESCO Recommendation on AI Ethics was adopted in 2021.
2. The OECD AI Principles date from 2019.
3. The EU AI Act of 2024 is a risk-based regulation that bans harmful uses such as social scoring.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The Global Partnership on AI, of which India is a member, works on responsible AI deployment.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
With reference to AI summits, consider the following statements:
1. The Bletchley Park AI Safety Summit in 2023 adopted the Bletchley Declaration.
2. The AI Action Summit in Paris in 2025 was co-chaired by India and France.
3. The India AI Impact Summit 2026 emphasised 'People, Planet, Progress'.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The text recommends a national AI authority in India like TRAI, risk-based regulation and human-in-the-loop oversight for critical decisions.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, consider the following statements:
1. It provides a flat subsidy of Rs 78,000 for plants of every size.
2. It is a Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy launched in 2024.
3. It targets rooftop solar installations for one crore households by 2027.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The subsidy varies with consumption: Rs 30,000 to Rs 60,000 for 1-2 kW, Rs 60,000 to Rs 78,000 for 2-3 kW and Rs 78,000 above 3 kW. Around 30 lakh households have rooftop solar under it.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to other features of the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, consider the following statements:
1. Collateral-free loans at around 7% interest are available for residential rooftop systems up to 3 kW.
2. One Model Solar Village is developed in each district.
3. A household which has already availed any other rooftop solar subsidy is still eligible.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: A household must not have availed any other subsidy for rooftop solar. The scheme also trains more than 3 lakh skilled workers and has a payment security mechanism for RESCO models.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana is described as which one of the following?
opts: A scheme to supply solar pumps for farmers
A mission for ultra-mega solar parks in deserts
A programme for solar street lights in cities
questions.why: The Central Financial Assistance depends on the household's average monthly electricity consumption and the suitable rooftop capacity.
